appDesc.message: Use 'Ctrl+Enter' for sending messages in AI chat services like ChatGPT. Prevents accidental sends and allows line breaks with Enter.

grantNote.message: Your browser calls this "read and change your data". It is only used to detect Enter key presses, never to read anything on the page.

optionsIntro.message: Sites shown with an Allow access button are opt-in. Enable them here, or from the extension icon while you are on the site. Pinning the icon to your toolbar makes that quicker.
